# Instructional Area: Numerical Representations & Relationships

## Question 1  *(TEKS 6.2B — Absolute Value in Context)*
A cave explorer descends to **−120 feet** relative to sea level while a drone hovers at **+95 feet**. Which statement is **true**?

- **A.** The drone is farther from sea level because $95 > -120$.
- **B.** The explorer is farther from sea level because $|-120| > |95|$.
- **C.** They are the same distance from sea level.
- **D.** The explorer is closer to sea level because $-120$ is negative.

---

## Question 2  *(TEKS 8.2C — Operations in Scientific Notation)*
Multiply and express the product in scientific notation:

$$(3 \times 10^{4}) \times (2 \times 10^{3})$$

- **A.** $6 \times 10^{7}$
- **B.** $6 \times 10^{12}$
- **C.** $5 \times 10^{7}$
- **D.** $6 \times 10^{1}$
